tick_empty.description: Reference: fu_tick on an empty isolated world (REST off).

tick_bindings_64.description: fu_tick with 64 CapBinding entities (3 of 4 with one CapDependsOn).

tick_bindings_256.description: fu_tick with 256 CapBinding entities (3 of 4 with one CapDependsOn).

tick_bindings_1000.description: fu_tick with 1000 idle CapBinding entities. Goal: <= 50 us idle.

tick_splines_256.description: fu_tick with 256 unchanged CapSpline (24 points). Goal: <= 50 us idle.

tick_trees_256.description: fu_tick with 256 NativeTree (~1 KB XML) waiting in SimWait. Goal: <= 50 us idle.

read_views_10000.description: fu_read_views over 10000 static entities. Goal: <= 50 us.

write_presented_10000.description: fu_write_presented acknowledging 10000 entities every frame. Goal: no work when nothing changed.

reload_script_6_entities.description: fu_set_managed_script reload of a 6-entity script with one value changed.

script_edit_900_entities.description: fu_script_edit on a 900-entity managed script. Goal: <= 1 ms edit commit.

tool_query_same.description: fu_query_json with the same expression every call.

tool_query_new.description: fu_query_once_json (uncached, no query slot) with a new valid expression every call. Goal: <= 3x tool_query_same (target is a multiple of that metric's ratio).

spawn_prefab_instance.description: Per-instance cost of creating 1000 prefab instances (one named child each) in one managed script.

typed_read_bodies_up.description: fu_query_read_data over ~1000 bodies, cached query with three up-traversal terms.

handles_survive_unrelated_script_set.description: 1 when an unrelated fu_set_managed_script leaves a read [in] handle unchanged.

tool_queries_keep_feature_slots.description: 1 when 40 distinct tool queries (fu_query_once_json) do not force a feature query to rebuild.
